svg.text: CAN → BLE gateway for the HUD — ESP32-S3 Super Mini
esp32s3_can_ble_gateway · powered from ACC · no SD, no RTC — CAN reception and BLE stream to the HUD
FH4R2 · QSPI PSRAM · RGB LED GPIO48
TX → TX, RX → RX (not crossed like UART)
100 nF at transceiver VCC and VIO
All GND are common (car GND = board GND).
Same-name flags (5V, 3V3p, GND) are connected; 3V3p = Super Mini 3V3 pin.
TJA1051T/3 only: S = VIO — transmitter disabled in hardware, the bus is never driven.
Bench with a single other node: S = GND and CAN_LISTEN_ONLY 0 (ACK needed).
Powered from the ignition line only: no sleep, no ACC sensing, zero parking current.
No Wi-Fi, no SD: the Super Mini LDO easily powers the ESP32 (VIO takes microamps).
Firmware: esp32s3_can_ble_gateway. Time for the camera comes from CAN 0x6B2.
